title: Assessment of Multimodal Large Language Models in Alignment with Human Values

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Ch³Ef dataset via a multiple-choice paradigm, where models are presented with image-text queries and must select the most appropriate, non-discriminatory response among human-annotated options using perplexity (PPL) scoring.
